persons.name: Jayasiṃhamallavarman
persons.evidence: śrīhnolavihārakuṭumbodbhavapradhānāṅgamahāpātraśrījayasīhamallavarmmaṇena satvārthahetunā ⁅s⁆vahastena likṣitaṃ ... pustakam idañ ca śrījayasīhamallavarmmaṇasya

date.as_written: samvat 496 māgha kṛṣṇapañcamyān tithau || svātinakṣatre || dhruvayoge || somavāsaradine

place.as_written: śrīnepāladeśe śrīśrīśrīpaśupatipaṭanād dakṣiṇasyān diśi || śrīvāghamatyāyān dakṣinākūle || śrīlalitapure śrīmānīgalottraravihāre

notes: The catalogue records Jayasiṃha Malla as king, but the colophon terms him pradhānāṅgamahāpātra of the Hnolavihāra lineage/family and clearly identifies him as the scribe copying with his own hand (svahastena likṣitam) and as the manuscript's owner.
